east.assumption: Diagonal independent reported errors only; not a supplied covariance

north.assumption: Diagonal independent reported errors only; not a supplied covariance

hst_cross_filter.remaining_gap: Exact export/reduction provenance specifying already-applied offsets, coordinate origins, sign conventions and shared-frame covariance

hst_time.historical_reader: 2022-06-17 BAGLE converts private reduction FITS t via Time(...,format=jyear,scale=utc).mjd
hst_time.next_required: Exact reduction/export mapping and frame provenance, or author-validated corrected epoch table; no blanket one-day shift or guessed epoch origin
hst_time.provenance_limit: Reader is contemporaneous independent corroboration; exact source FITS and ASCII export script tying these deposited bytes to the reader are not public/recovered

likelihood.DW: logL_ground_phot+logL_HST_phot+logL_HST_ast, with each datum weighted by its reported/model noise
likelihood.GP_scope: Supplement AppendixF describes magnitude GP+Gaussian likelihood, HST diagonal covariance; Table19 has no GP hyperparameters for OB110462, so do not claim an exact deposited OB110462 GP recovery without run configuration
likelihood.historical_code_caveat: 20220617 weighted solver has phot_ast_equal and all_equal choices; all_equal includes an overall factor1e-3*n_data/n_sets in addition to1/n_i and counts astrometric coordinates twice. It is not evidence of which precise run configuration generated published samples
likelihood.independent_fit_comparison: A new rectilinear diagonal fit is a screening analysis with distinct likelihood/prior assumptions, not reproduction of the published parallax+joint posterior

photometric_time.historical_reader_convention: BAGLE labels OGLE JD numbers UTC; its MOA reader explicitly undoes heliocentric light-travel correction using observer location, coordinates and Time(jd,utc)
photometric_time.limit: That code reads a different raw MOA6-column format, not the deposited3-column calibrated table; do not apply it blindly to deposited bytes
photometric_time.native_label: HJD; OGLE3 has explicit2450000 offset, benchmark is full HJD
photometric_time.precision_annual_parallax: Not validated for these data until relevant source timing conventions are established
photometric_time.rectilinear_relative_time: Allowed under a documented limited relative-time convention; numeric origin changes are not a physical clock/heliocentric conversion

ogle3.finding: Source project explicitly asks citation of Wyrzykowski etal; a dataset-wide redistribution license was not found in project page/packaged README. Public analysis and source attribution permitted by project use invitation; blanket republication rights not inferred
ogle3.release_policy: Keep immutable raw files external/private reproducibility store; ship fetch/hash instructions and analysis products, not raw OGLE observations, absent clarified redistribution terms

zenodo6607578.not_software_license: Do not relabel third-party observations as BHSM code license
